=={{header|ghul}}==

<syntaxhighlight lang="ghul">
use IO.Std.write_line;

// The negative argument is checked once, on entry. `rec` is how a function literal refers to
// itself, so the recursion that follows needs no helper function and no name at all: the literal
// is applied where it is written.
let fibonacci = n =>
    if n < 0 then
        throw System.ArgumentException("fibonacci is not defined for a negative argument")
    else
        (i rec => if i < 2 then i else rec(i - 1) + rec(i - 2) fi)(n)
    fi;

for n in 0::10 do
    write_line("fibonacci({n}) = {fibonacci(n)}");
od
</syntaxhighlight>

{{out}}
<pre>
fibonacci(0) = 0
fibonacci(1) = 1
fibonacci(2) = 1
fibonacci(3) = 2
fibonacci(4) = 3
fibonacci(5) = 5
fibonacci(6) = 8
fibonacci(7) = 13
fibonacci(8) = 21
fibonacci(9) = 34
fibonacci(10) = 55
</pre>
